permissions.name: kempo-inventory:items:read
permissions.description: View inventory items, fields and stock movements

permissions.name: kempo-inventory:stock:adjust
permissions.description: Add or remove stock on inventory items

permissions.name: kempo-inventory:fields:manage
permissions.description: Create, edit and delete custom item fields

groups.name: kempo-inventory:manager
groups.description: Can view and manage items and stock levels

groups.name: kempo-inventory:admin
groups.description: Can manage items and stock levels, and set up the custom fields items have

settings.name: media_provider
settings.description: Where new photos and files are uploaded: auto, kempo-media or kempo-files. Auto uses kempo-files when kempo-thumbs is installed to thumbnail it, otherwise kempo-media.

settings.name: import_max_mb
settings.description: The largest import file (a .json or .zip made by Export) the admin Import accepts, in MB.

settings.name: public_read
settings.description: Let anyone, signed in or not, browse the inventory (items, categories, photos). They never see stock counts. Off by default: reading otherwise needs the items:read permission.

settings.name: public_photos
settings.description: Photos uploaded to kempo-files are viewable by anyone with the link, so every person who can read the inventory sees them (kempo-files otherwise needs each of them to have its files:download permission). Turn off to keep photos behind that permission.

settings.name: category_image_ratio
settings.description: The aspect ratio category images are shown at, as width:height (4:3, 1:1, 16:9). Images are cropped to fit, never stretched.

settings.name: item_image_ratio
settings.description: The aspect ratio item photos are shown at, as width:height (4:3, 1:1, 16:9). Images are cropped to fit, never stretched.
